title: Your First Program
story: Imagine teaching your dog a new trick. You say 'sit,' and your dog sits. A program works the same way — you give the computer instructions, and it follows them exactly, one by one.
why: Every app, game, and website you use starts with a program like this one.
analogy: A program is like a recipe: you write step-by-step instructions, and the computer follows them exactly.
try_it: Change the greeting inside the quotes. Try your name, a different language, or an emoji!
tips: Every statement ends with a semicolon ;
Text in quotes is called a string
Comments with // are ignored by the computer
use xiom.io; goes at the very top of your file
common_mistakes: Forgetting the semicolon ; at the end
Spelling io.println wrong — it's println, not printline
